summary: Surf Air Mobility Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a Master Subscription Agreement between its subsidiary Surf Air Technologies Inc. and Wheels Up Experience Inc. for Enterprise BrokerOS software. The agreement has a two-year initial term with an $8.0 million subscription fee and an optional one-year extension for an additional $4.2 million, payable quarterly. No board recommendation or advisors are named. This is a routine commercial software contract, not a special situation like an acquisition or divestiture. No deal terms such as price per share or premium apply.
